Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

head — the top part of the body. Example: My head hurts.
face — the front of your head. Example: I have got a round face.
eye — the part of the face you see with. Example: I have got brown eyes.
ear — the part of the body you hear with. Example: My ear hurts.
nose — the part of the face you smell with. Example: My nose is small.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What is the matter?
• My ... hurts.
• I have got ...
• It is fine.
• Point to your ...

Grammar focus: Expressing pain with 'have got' / 'feel'.
Use have got for body parts: I have got two eyes. Use my + part + hurts: My head hurts. Ask What is the matter?
